articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and 3D
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, video streams, and 3D scene data in a single context window. Early benchmarks show a 40% improvement on SWE-Bench Full and novel capabilities in spatial reasoning tasks. The model also introduces a refined chain-of-thought architecture that significantly reduces hallucination rates on factual queries.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Gold-Medal Performance on International Math Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 solved 5 out of 6 problems on the 2026 International Mathematical Olympiad, earning a score equivalent to a gold medal. The system uses a novel neuro-symbolic verification loop that generates formal proofs in Lean 4 alongside natural-language reasoning. This represents a significant leap in AI's ability to perform open-ended mathematical discovery rather than pattern matching on known problem types.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Deploys 500 Humanoid Workers Across BMW's Spartanburg Plant
articles.summary: Figure AI completed the largest single-site deployment of general-purpose humanoid robots, with 500 Figure 03 units now operating across BMW's South Carolina manufacturing facility. The robots handle parts kitting, quality inspection, and inter-station material transport using on-device vision-language models for task adaptation. BMW reports a 22% throughput increase in mixed-model assembly lines where the robots supplement human workers.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Demonstrates Autonomous Disaster Response in DARPA Urban Search Trials
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics' electric Atlas robot completed a full autonomous urban search-and-rescue course during DARPA's latest evaluation, navigating collapsed structures, breaching doors, and locating simulated victims without human teleoperation. The robot leveraged real-time 3D scene reconstruction and a large behavior model trained on thousands of hours of simulation and real-world manipulation data. DARPA officials called it the first credible demonstration of fully autonomous humanoid disaster response.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers' Framework for Enterprise AI Governance
articles.summary: Anthropic open-sourced a new Constitutional Classifiers framework that allows enterprises to define auditable, hierarchical policy layers governing AI agent behavior in production systems. The framework integrates directly with Claude-based agentic workflows and provides real-time compliance logging against regulatory requirements including the EU AI Act. Early adopters in financial services report it reduces policy-violation incidents by over 85% compared to prompt-only guardrails.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node with Backside Power Delivery
articles.summary: TSMC announced volume production on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node at its Kaohsiung fab, featuring backside power delivery network (BSPDN) technology that decouples power and signal routing. The node delivers an 18% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, directly benefiting next-generation AI accelerator and mobile SoC designs. Apple, Nvidia, and AMD are confirmed as launch customers with chips expected in devices by early 2027.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Logical Qubit Error Rates Below Fault-Tolerance Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum jointly announced achieving logical qubit error rates of 10⁻⁸ using their hybrid topological-trapped-ion architecture, breaking below the key fault-tolerance threshold needed for practical quantum error correction. The demonstration used 32 logical qubits running a quantum chemistry simulation that matched classical supercomputer results. Researchers say this milestone puts a useful, error-corrected quantum computer on a credible 3-5 year timeline.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Robots Begin Limited Household Beta with Over-the-Air Task Learning
articles.summary: Tesla started a closed beta program placing Optimus Gen 3 robots in approximately 1,000 employee households, testing domestic tasks including laundry folding, dishwasher loading, and grocery unpacking. The robots use a new imitation-learning pipeline where users demonstrate a task once and the system generalizes via a foundation world model. Tesla says the OTA task-update mechanism allows the robot's domestic skill library to expand weekly without hardware changes.
